description: Canadair CT-133 Silver Star Mk 3, c/n T33-162, ex CF-FIF, delivered August 1973, damaged in an accident 5 January 1977 and installed as a monument in Oruro in 1982. Photographed in place 18 October 2025 (airhistory.net, 'Off-Airport' Oruro). The exact plaza/avenue has not been established; coordinates left blank.
